The '''Republic watchtower''' was a part of the Republic's detention complex located in the [[High Security Section]] of the [[Belsavis prison]]. Following the prison break, it housed an outpost of Republic forces, including [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Hauer]], [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Camren]], [[Officer/Legends|Officer]] [[Serik]] and [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Tudos]].
